classifications.rationale: Executive departments and agencies must later place a specified minimum-wage clause in covered contracts and solicitations, creating the legally consequential payment condition through subsequent procurement actions.
classifications.evidence: Executive departments and agencies (agencies) shall, to the extent permitted by law, ensure that new contracts, contract-like instruments, and solicitations (collectively referred to as "contracts"), as described in section 7 of this order, include a clause

classifications.rationale: The Secretary must later issue binding regulations implementing the order’s substantive contractor-wage requirements, although the Secretary retains discretion to provide appropriate exclusions.
classifications.evidence: The Secretary shall issue regulations by October 1, 2014

classifications.rationale: The Federal Acquisition Regulatory Council must later amend binding procurement regulations to require inclusion of the prescribed contract clause in covered solicitations and contracts.
classifications.evidence: the Federal Acquisition Regulatory Council shall issue regulations in the Federal Acquisition Regulation to provide for inclusion of the contract clause

classifications.rationale: This segment inseparably combines a mandate for agencies to produce later contractual compliance consequences, discretionary regulatory guidance, an internal enforcement-authority assignment, and provisions immediately addressing dispute rights and severability.
classifications.evidence: This order creates no rights under the Contract Disputes Act
